contract_term.quote: The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.

scope_of_deliverables.quote: The County is seeking proposals from experienced and qualified consultants to conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, followed by the development of a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County's appointed project team members, and to serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, develop a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County's appointed project team members, and serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent.

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents are to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal. The Pricing Schedule must be completed by filling in the blank spaces under the headings “Unit Price” and “Total Bid” for each item and filling in the blank space for the overall “Total Bid” amount. Rates must be provided in Canadian ($) funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for applicable sales taxes, which should be itemized separately. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour, equipment, and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law.
pricing_structure.value: TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure)

vendor_experience_required.quote: The Proponent’s appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions. Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.
vendor_experience_required.value: Project Manager: 5 years ERP-related projects, led 2 ERP projects in last 7 years; Project team members: 3 years ERP-related projects in last 7 years

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

data_security_requirements.quote: Security Protocols: Define the security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system. This encompasses role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process. Vendor Demonstration Facilitation: Assist the Procurement Personnel with organizing and facilitating each Vendor demonstration, ensuring alignment with the predefined agenda and objectives and that the County provides a conducive environment for practical demonstrations.
